children: Motilal Oswal's research report on IndusInd Bank

IndusInd Bank (IIB) reported 2QFY27 PAT of INR12.4b (MOFSLe PAT: INR9.3b), attributed to healthy NII growth and strong other income. NII grew 4% YoY (down 2% QoQ) to INR45.7b (4% beat). NIM contracted 12bp QoQ to 3.23% vs adj. NIM of 3.35% in 1QFY27. Other income grew 26% QoQ (21% beat), while opex increased 7% QoQ/declined 2% YoY to INR39.4b (3% higher vs MOFSLe). Net advances rose 11% QoQ (11% YoY), led by strong momentum in the consumer banking and mid-market group, while unsecured retail segment like PL & CC declined. Deposits rose 3.4% QoQ (up 10.1% YoY), while CASA ratio dipped 150 bp QoQ to 27.9%.
We raise our earnings by 19%/17% in FY27/FY28E and estimate IIB’s RoA at 0.8%/1.1% for FY27E/FY28E. Reiterate Neutral rating with a TP of INR1,050 (based on 1.1x Mar’28E ABV).
